note: Issue #71: text and UI size. text_scale is the one number that sizes every UI element: every panel, label, prompt, box and HUD read-out grows or shrinks with it (it is the window's UI scale, so layouts keep their shape). The player changes it in F11 > HUD and it is saved per machine with the HUD colour (user://settings/ui.cfg); this is the default and the slider's range. sizes: base font sizes (at text_scale 1.0) for the screens that read worst before: the dialogue box, the job box, the ship and speeder read-outs, and the race's big centre text (race_big: the countdown, GO, CRASHED; race_hint: the line under it). The race text shrinks below its size if it would not fit the window.

credit_toast.note: The credit toast (CreditToast): '+120 credits' / '-40 credits' under the banner's credits, top right, newest on top. Seconds to come up, hold and fade; how many lines at most; the base font size (text_scale sizes it); fight_gap: px between a space fight's read-out (top right) and the first line, which move under it during a fight.
